list.deleteDraftFailed: The draft payroll process could not be deleted. Please try again, or contact your administrator if the problem persists.
list.reprocessAffected: {n, plural, one {# employee affected} other {# employees affected}}
list.reprocessBadgeNote: Payroll-affecting data changed after this run was processed, so its payslips, statutory figures and totals are the earlier numbers. Reprocess the affected employees to bring it up to date — the run cannot be closed until that is done.
list.notPublishedBanner: {n} payroll run(s) are calculated but not published — the employees in them cannot see their payslips yet. Open a run and close it to publish.
list.runsInMonth: {n, plural, =0 {No payroll runs} one {# payroll run} other {# payroll runs}}

batch.subtitle: Payroll batch
batch.paymentSummaryTitle: Download a CSV of employee, bank, account and net pay for manual bank upload.
batch.transactionDetailTitle: Download every employee’s earnings, deductions, employer contributions and totals for this run as an Excel file.
batch.disclaimer: Draft figures. Statutory amounts are computed from the verified Malaysian rules in effect at period end. Review every payslip before closing — once closed, the batch is immutable. Bank files (CP39 / KWSP / PERKESO) are generated separately.
batch.leaversHint: Employees terminating in this period. The suggested in-lieu amount pays out their unused annual leave at 1/26 of monthly wages per day — advisory only, add it as a bonus if you choose to pay it.
batch.inputsHint: Per-employee overtime, bonus and PCB inputs entered before generating. Overtime is keyed as manual ringgit amounts you compute (the system applies no rate) — use the ORP / hourly basis shown for each employee, or Prefill overtime to let the s.60A engine compute it from attendance. Unpaid-leave days are derived automatically from approved unpaid leave.
batch.prefillHint: Prefill overtime from approved attendance, or queue approved taxable claims onto this batch.
batch.fieldOtHint: Manual ringgit amounts you compute — the system does not apply a rate. Use the ORP / hourly basis shown for each employee.
batch.fieldOtFlatTitle: Flat OT (RM) — any contractual/ex-gratia overtime at the plain hourly rate. Enter the ringgit amount.
batch.fieldOtNormalTitle: Normal working-day OT (RM) — EA s.60A(3): 1.5× the hourly rate for hours beyond normal. Compute and enter the ringgit amount.
batch.fieldOtRestTitle: Rest-day OT (RM) — EA s.60(3): ½-day ORP up to half normal hours, 1 day ORP up to normal hours, then 2× hourly beyond. Compute and enter the ringgit amount.
batch.fieldOtHolidayTitle: Public-holiday OT (RM) — EA s.60D(3): 2 days' ORP at the ordinary rate plus 3× hourly for hours beyond normal. Compute and enter the ringgit amount.
batch.otBasisTitle: EA s.60I(1A) basis for this employee: ORP (ordinary rate of pay) = monthly wages ÷ 26; hourly = ORP ÷ 8. Reference rates: 1.5× normal day, 2× rest day, 3× public holiday. Read-only.
batch.otAboveCeiling: Above EA s.60A RM{ceiling} ceiling — statutory OT not mandated; any OT here is contractual.
batch.otClobberWarn: This row's overtime was prefilled from attendance (statutory s.60A engine). Saving will overwrite it with your manually entered amounts. Continue?
batch.fieldTp1Title: TP1: optional deductions/rebates the employee claims this month (reduces MTD).
batch.fieldZakatTitle: Zakat paid via salary deduction — offsets this month's PCB.
batch.noActiveEmployees: No active employees in this period.

componentImport.title: Import pay components (CSV)
componentImport.description: Bulk-add one-off allowances, deductions, OT or bonuses to this draft batch. Columns: employee (email), component (code), amount, notes.
componentImport.matchHint: Matched by employee email + component code.

batch.scopedCaption: This run is scoped to selected employees. Overtime, shift differential, loan and zakat prefills below still apply company-wide; out-of-scope rows are ignored at processing. Claims prefill is scoped correctly.
batch.holidayWarning: {country}/{state} {year}: only {loaded} of {required} public holidays are loaded — rest-day/OT calculations may be affected.
batch.allowanceGateWarning: Typed pay-components is off — a transfer will be recorded but won't reach payslips until it is enabled.
batch.resetDescription: Are you sure you want to reset this payroll process? All payroll calculation results for this payroll run will be cleared, and the process will return to Draft status. This action should only be performed by authorized users.
batch.scopeUnattachedTitle: {n} employee(s) outside this run's scope have transactions waiting
batch.scopeUnattachedWarning: This run is narrowed to selected employees. Calculating it will not collect the transactions below — they stay outstanding until a full run for this month is calculated.
batch.outstandingTxnTitle: {n} transaction(s) for this month, totalling {amount}, have not reached a payslip
batch.outstandingTxnHint: The oldest was entered on {when}. Returning this run to Draft and calculating it again collects all of them.
batch.outstandingTxnAfterProcessing: Some were entered after this run was calculated. Transactions are only collected when a run is calculated for the first time, so a later entry is not picked up.
batch.outstandingTxnLeftOutByScope: Some belong to employees this run's scope left out, so calculating it did not collect them.
batch.resetCollectsOutstanding: Returning to Draft and calculating again also collects every outstanding transaction for this month.
batch.reprocessDoesNotCollect: Reprocessing selected employees does NOT collect outstanding transactions for the month — only returning the run to Draft and calculating it again does.
batch.resetOnlyProcessed: Only a processed payroll process can be reset.
batch.resetAdminOnly: Only an administrator can reset a payroll process.
batch.resetReasonRequired: A reason is required to revert a processed payroll to draft.
batch.lockedNote: This payroll process is locked — payslips have been generated. To make corrections, an administrator must reset it to Draft.
batch.resetReasonPlaceholder: Why is this run being reset? (recorded in the audit trail)
batch.resetDisabled: Resetting a payroll process is switched off for this environment. Ask your administrator to enable payroll reset first.
batch.reprocessHint: Tick the employees who need correcting and reprocess just them. Only the ticked employees are recalculated in place — everyone else's payslips stay untouched — and the run's totals update by delta. Runs as a queued job so a double-click can't duplicate it.
batch.reprocessReasonPlaceholder: Why are these employees being reprocessed? (recorded in the audit trail)
batch.reprocessAdminOnly: You do not have permission to reprocess payroll.
batch.reprocessNoneSelected: Select at least one employee to reprocess.
batch.reprocessNotProcessed: Only a processed payroll run can be reprocessed.
batch.reprocessReviewTitle: Before you submit — you are about to reprocess {n} of {total} employee(s).
batch.reprocessReviewNote: The other {n} payslip(s) are not touched. The run's totals are adjusted by the difference only.
batch.reprocessPeriodClosed: This pay period is closed, so nothing in this payroll run can be recalculated. Reopen the period first.
batch.reprocessWhyPriorMonths: Earlier months were revised ({periods}), so the cumulative tax replays.
batch.reprocessHistoryNote: Earlier reprocessing on this payroll run. Nothing is deleted, and it stays in the audit trail as well.
batch.historyEmpty: No recorded events for this run yet.
batch.historyResetCounts: {payslips} payslip(s) cleared · {loans} loan instalment(s) reversed · {claims} claim(s) returned to queue
batch.unlockLockedNote: This payroll process is closed and immutable. Unlocking reopens it for correction — a controlled, audited action.
batch.unlockDescription: Unlocking returns this closed run to Processed so it can be corrected. This is high-risk: statutory returns or payment files may already have been produced from it. A reason is required.
batch.unlockReasonPlaceholder: Why is this closed run being unlocked? (recorded in the audit trail)
batch.unlockConfirmBody: Are you sure you want to unlock this payroll? This will change its status from Closed back to Processed so it can be reviewed, amended, and reprocessed.
batch.unlockWarnPayment: ⚠ The payment summary for this run has already been exported — payment may have been disbursed.
batch.unlockWarnStatutory: ⚠ Statutory returns (EPF/SOCSO/EIS/LHDN) were already recorded for this month — an amended filing may be needed.
batch.unlockDone: Payroll process unlocked and returned to Processed.
batch.unlockDoneWarned: Payroll process unlocked. Note: payment and/or statutory submissions had already occurred — review whether an amended filing is needed.
batch.unlockNotClosed: Only a closed payroll process can be unlocked.
batch.unlockPermissionDenied: You do not have permission to unlock a closed payroll process.
batch.unlockReasonRequired: A reason is required to unlock a closed payroll process.
batch.unpublishedBannerTitle: These payslips are not visible to employees yet
batch.unpublishedBannerBody: This run is calculated but not published. Employees cannot see their payslips until you close it. Closing notifies every employee in this run that their payslip is ready, and publishes it — immediately, or on the company's configured payslip release date where one is set.
batch.closeConfirmTitle: Close this run and publish it to employees?
batch.closeConfirmBody: This publishes {n} payslip(s) to the employees in this run and notifies each of them. Publication is immediate unless this company has a configured payslip release date, in which case it is scheduled for that date. Once closed, the run is immutable.
batch.closeDone: Payroll closed — payslips published to employees.
batch.closeNotProcessed: Only a processed payroll process can be closed.
batch.closePermissionDenied: You do not have permission to close a payroll process.
batch.publishedScheduledOn: Closed — payslips become visible to employees on {when}
batch.publishedNoRecord: Published, but no close was recorded for this run — it was imported from a previous payroll system rather than closed here.
batch.preChecksAllClear: All checks passed — employee information is complete for this run.
batch.preChecksBlockerHint: {n} employee(s) have no current salary record. Previously they would have been silently left out of the run — payroll cannot be processed until this is fixed (or the run scope excludes them).
batch.preChecksPayModeBlockerHint: {n} employee(s) have a Custom Period pay structure, which payroll has no calculation for. This run would otherwise pay them the monthly-equivalent basic for a structure that was deliberately marked as not monthly. Change the Pay Mode on their Basic Salary record, or leave them out of this run, then run payroll again.
batch.preChecksTp3BlockerHint: {n} employee(s) have a Form TP3 for this year that their Payroll tab figures do not match, so this run would treat their previous employment as nothing and under-deduct PCB. Open Form TP3 for each of them and save it, then run payroll again.
batch.preChecksWarningHint: {n} check(s) need your attention. You can still process payroll, but you will be asked to confirm.

preChecks.zeroBasic: Paid daily or hourly with no rate on record — rate × days would pay nothing
preChecks.staleBasicComponent: Outdated BASIC pay item — the Personnel salary record is used
preChecks.currencyMismatch: Salary currency is not MYR — the amount is processed as entered
preChecks.hrdfSubjectUnregistered: Subject to HRDF, but the company is not registered — no levy is charged
preChecks.unpayablePayMode: A pay structure this system cannot calculate — the Custom Period pay mode has no payroll calculation
preChecks.tp3YearMismatch: Form TP3 for this year has not reached the payroll figures — previous employment would be counted as nothing
preChecks.nothingPayable: No monthly basic salary — payroll leaves them out of a month with nothing else to pay them

batch.preChecksBlockedError: Cannot process payroll: {n} employee(s) have no current salary record. Fix the pre-processing checks first.
batch.preChecksBlockedPayModeError: Cannot process payroll: {n} employee(s) have a Custom Period pay structure that payroll cannot calculate. Change the Pay Mode on their Basic Salary record, or leave them out of this run.
batch.preChecksBlockedTp3Error: Cannot process payroll: {n} employee(s) have a Form TP3 for this year that has not reached their payroll figures. Open Form TP3 for each of them and save it first.
batch.generatedWithSkipped: Payslips generated — {n} employee(s) skipped. The list below names them and says why.

skipped.title: Employees skipped by this run
skipped.note: Employees this run had nothing to pay were not processed. They have no payslip on this run and none of their transactions were used up.

reason.NO_TRANSACTION_FOR_CYCLE: No transaction entry for this payroll cycle
reason.NO_ADDITIONAL_PAY_THIS_RUN: Nothing for this run type — their standing monthly pay is paid by the regular run
reason.NOTHING_PAYABLE_THIS_PERIOD: No basic salary and nothing payable this period — nothing was paid, so nothing was filed
reason.DEDUCTION_ONLY_THIS_PERIOD: Only a deduction was waiting and no pay to take it from — deducting from nothing would owe them money

batch.preChecksConfirmRequired: Please confirm the pre-processing warnings before generating payslips.
batch.preConfirmDescription: {n} pre-processing check(s) are unresolved (missing statutory profile or bank details). Affected employees may get default statutory treatment and be missing from the payment file.
batch.provenanceNote: “Rules” is the statutory ruleset version that produced the figures on that payslip; “rev” counts how many times the payslip has been recalculated. Both were always recorded — this run just never showed them.
batch.disclosureEmpty: No payslip in this run has been recalculated.
batch.disclosureGrossUnchanged: Gross pay unchanged at {gross}, but these statutory figures moved:
batch.disclosureGrossChanged: Gross pay {before} → {after}; statutory figures that moved:
batch.disclosureCauseRuleset: This payslip was recalculated under a different statutory ruleset version: {before} → {after}.
batch.disclosureCauseRulesetNote: A version change does not by itself change a rate or band — some versions only add optional rules that apply to nobody unless a pay item or an employee is explicitly flagged. Check that version’s notes before attributing the movement to it.
batch.disclosureCausePriorMonths: Earlier months in the same tax year were recalculated after this payslip was last computed ({periods}). Malaysian monthly tax is cumulative, so revising an earlier month legitimately moves this one even though its gross is unchanged.
batch.disclosureCauseOwnInputs: No ruleset change and no earlier-month recalculation was recorded in between, so the movement came from this payslip’s own inputs — a relief, a zakat election, or a contribution setting.
batch.disclosureCauseRulesetUnknown: One of the two calculations has no ruleset version recorded, so a version change can be neither confirmed nor ruled out.

pendingMoney.title: Pending transactions
pendingMoney.hint: Everything queued against this run that is not basic salary, whichever screen it was entered on. Twelve entry points write five different tables; this is the one place they are all visible before you generate.
pendingMoney.empty: Nothing is queued. This run will pay basic salary and the statutory calculation only.
pendingMoney.inert: {n} recorded transactions will NOT be paid by this run: the pay-item features that read them are switched off for this tenant. They are excluded from the totals above.

batch.recalcBannerTitle: This run needs recalculation for {n} employee(s).
batch.recalcBannerBody: One-off transactions were added, changed or removed after this run was processed, so the payslips, statutory figures and totals below are the earlier numbers. Reprocess the affected employees to bring them up to date; the run cannot be closed until that is done.
batch.closeBlockedByCoverage: This run cannot be closed: {n} employee(s) changed company inside this period, and their payslips do not cover the month exactly — some days are unpaid or paid twice. Process or reprocess the other company's run for the same period first.
batch.generateBlockedByCounterpartClosed: Cannot process payroll: {n} employee(s) changed company inside this period, and the other company's run for the same period is already closed, so the days it owes can no longer be paid on it. Unlock that run first.
batch.closeBlockedRecalc: This run cannot be closed until the employees whose transactions changed after processing have been recalculated.
batch.reprocessGroupNewTitle: New / Pending — {n} employee(s) eligible for this month with no payslip on this run
batch.reprocessReasonProcessed: Already paid on this run. Reprocessing recalculates this payslip in place.
batch.reprocessReasonNew: Eligible for this month and has no payslip on this run.
batch.reprocessReasonOutsideScope: This run was set up for a chosen list of people and this person is not on it. Ticking them adds them to that list.
batch.reprocessReasonNotReady: Cannot be paid yet — {gaps}. Fix the Personnel record first.
batch.reprocessGapZeroBasic: a salary record that would pay nothing
batch.reprocessGapPayMode: a pay structure that cannot be calculated
batch.reprocessNewCollects: Adding someone new DOES collect the one-off transactions already waiting for them this month.
batch.reprocessReviewAddNote: {n} of them are being added to this run for the first time: their payslip is created, the run’s headcount goes up, and their loans, claims and one-off payments are settled with it.
batch.reprocessWhyAdded: This is their first payslip on this run, so there is nothing to compare it with.
batch.removeHint: Remove one or more employees' calculated results from this processed run. Everyone else's payslips stay exactly as they are, the run stays Processed, and its totals come down by the removed amounts only.
batch.removeNotPersonnel: Nothing on the employee's Personnel record is changed — only this cycle's calculated result.
batch.removeSearchPlaceholder: Search by employee ID or name
batch.removeNoEmployees: This run has no payroll results to remove.
batch.removeReasonPlaceholder: Why is this employee's payroll being removed?
batch.removeReasonMissing: A reason is required to remove an employee's payroll.
batch.removeReviewNote: The other {n} payroll results are not touched and the run stays Processed.
batch.removeReviewBackNote: Each removed employee reappears under New / Pending on the Reprocess screen, where you correct them and process them again.
batch.removeConfirmBody: The selected {n} employees' payroll results for this run will be removed. Their loan instalment for the month, any claims this run marked as paid, and their one-off transaction entries are put back. This is not a Reset: nobody else on the run is affected and the run stays Processed.
batch.removeWholeRunRefused: You have selected every employee on this run. Clearing a whole run is a Reset — use Reset Payroll instead.
batch.removePeriodClosed: This pay period is closed. Reopen it before removing an employee payroll.
batch.removeAdminOnly: You do not have permission to remove an employee's payroll on this run.
batch.removeNotProcessed: Only a processed payroll run can have an employee payroll removed.
batch.removeDisabled: Removing an employee payroll is switched off for this environment. It uses the same setting as Reset Payroll, so ask your administrator to enable payroll reset first.
batch.removeModuleOff: Additional payroll cycles are switched off, so a removed employee could not be processed again on this run. Removing an employee payroll is unavailable until they are enabled.
batch.removeNoneSelected: Select at least one employee to remove.
batch.removeNotOnRun: None of the selected employees have a payroll result on this run.
batch.removeResultTitle: {n} employee payroll removed. {total} remain on this run.
batch.removeWarnPaymentExported: The payment file for this month has already been exported.
batch.removeWarnStatutoryFiled: A statutory return for this month has already been filed with its agency.
batch.removeWarnLaterPeriods: Later months already processed for the selected employees: {periods}. Their tax to date in those months was worked out with this payroll result included.
batch.removeHistoryNote: Every removal on this run — who did it, when, why, and the figures that were removed. This is the only remaining copy of those figures.
batch.reprocessSearchPlaceholder: Search by employee ID or name
batch.preChecksNothingPayableHint: {n} employee(s) have no monthly basic salary. This is not a fault and does not stop the run: payroll leaves them out of any month where nothing is payable to them, names them again on the result, and pays them normally in a month where a transaction is keyed for them.
batch.preChecksNothingPayableNoRemark: No reason was recorded on the salary record.
batch.reprocessReasonNothingPayable: Deliberately left out of this run — no monthly basic salary and nothing was payable this month. Tick them only if something has been keyed for them since.
batch.preChecksBadgeLegend: Anything marked “Blocks processing” must be fixed before this run. Anything marked “Warning” can still be processed, after you confirm it. Anything marked “Will be skipped” needs nothing from you.
batch.reprocessNothingPayableFull: No payable earnings were resolved for this pay period. Payroll recalculation was not performed. Existing payslip, run membership, transactions and history were retained.
batch.reprocessSucceededReason: A new payroll result was saved for this employee.
batch.reprocessChildConfigurationReason: The configured child relief and qualifying-child counts conflict. Review PCB configuration before recalculating.
batch.reprocessConfigurationReason: Required payroll configuration is incomplete. Review this employee’s payroll records before recalculating.
batch.reprocessNothingPayableShort: Nothing payable in this pay period; recalculation skipped.
batch.reprocessPreviousResultRetained: Previous payroll result retained; the figures shown are from that saved result.
batch.reprocessReviewTaxConfiguration: Review tax configuration for this run
batch.reprocessStoppedPartial: Processing stopped before all selected employees finished. Saved outcomes remain valid. Review them before trying again.
batch.reprocessLegacyOutcomeUnavailable: This earlier job did not record individual outcomes. Its saved calculation history remains available below.

reports.layerABanner: Layer-A report — a human-readable summary to remit from or hand to an accountant. Byte-exact agency files (CP39 / KWSP / PERKESO / bank) come in a later slice, each sourced + verified.
reports.noBatch: No payroll batch found for {company} · {period}. Run payroll for this period first.
reports.readinessTitle: {count, plural, one {# employee missing identifiers needed to file:} other {# employees missing identifiers needed to file:}}
reports.cp39DownloadTitle: e-Data PCB upload file (LHDN Exhibit 4). DRAFT until verified against e-PCB Plus.
reports.socsoEisDownloadTitle: Combined SOCSO + EIS contribution textfile (ASSIST, v2.0 with SKBBK)
reports.worklistMoved: The CP22 and CP22A notices now live on Statutory Forms, with the rest of the LHDN filings.
reports.worksheetIntro: Deciding how a second payroll run in one month should be treated for EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB?
reports.ackRefHint: The reference the agency issued when it accepted this return. Required — it is the proof the filing happened.
reports.filedOnHint: The day the return was lodged with the agency. Leave blank for today.
reports.markFiledDoneAmended: Return marked filed as an amended return — this period already had a filed return.
reports.reverseFilingDone: Filing mark reversed. The return is a draft again.
reports.errFilingForbidden: You do not have permission to mark a statutory return filed.
reports.errFilingNotFound: That statutory report could not be found.
reports.errAckRefRequired: Enter the acknowledgement reference the agency issued.
reports.errAckRefTooLong: The acknowledgement reference is too long (maximum 120 characters).
reports.errFilingReasonRequired: Enter a reason for undoing this filing mark.
reports.errInvalidFiledOn: Enter the filing date as a valid date.
reports.errFiledOnInFuture: A return cannot be filed on a future date.
reports.errAlreadyFiled: This return is already marked filed. Undo it first, or file the regenerated return.
reports.errNotFiled: This return is not marked filed.
reports.errFilingFailed: The return could not be marked filed.

statutoryForms.pageDescription: Every Malaysian statutory submission, grouped by the authority you file it with.
statutoryForms.body_epf_hint: Provident fund contributions, filed through i-Akaun (Employer).
statutoryForms.body_perkeso_hint: SOCSO and EIS are one submission, filed together through PERKESO ASSIST.
statutoryForms.body_lhdn_hint: Monthly tax deduction, the annual return, and the joiner and leaver notices.
statutoryForms.body_other_hint: Levies and deductions filed with anyone other than EPF, PERKESO or LHDN — HRD Corp, zakat, PTPTN, Tabung Haji, co-operatives.
statutoryForms.shelfEmpty: Nothing is filed with this body yet. A form built later appears here on its own, with its own deadline and its own downloads — this page does not have to be redesigned to take one.
statutoryForms.noneForCountry: No statutory forms are configured for this company’s country.
statutoryForms.link_ea_hint: Each employee’s annual statement of remuneration, opened from the year’s employee list. English and Bahasa Malaysia are two separate entries here, and each one produces its own language whatever language this screen is set to.
statutoryForms.link_cp22_hint: New joiner and cessation notifications to LHDN, driven by your hire and termination dates. Filed through the e-CP22 service on MyTax; what you download here is what you key in, and your own record.
statutoryForms.worklistDescription: New-hire (CP22) and cessation (CP22A) notifications due to LHDN for {company}. File in MyTax; this surfaces what's outstanding.
statutoryForms.noBatch: No payroll batch found for {company} · {period}. Run payroll for this period first.
statutoryForms.readinessTitle: {count, plural, one {# employee missing identifiers needed to file:} other {# employees missing identifiers needed to file:}}
statutoryForms.cp39DownloadTitle: e-Data PCB upload file (LHDN Exhibit 4). DRAFT until verified against e-PCB Plus.
statutoryForms.cp39ReviewTitle: Check the statement, fill in the preparer block, then download the printed CP39 or the same content as plain text. For your records and as a payment cover document — the LHDN submission itself is the e-Data PCB file.
statutoryForms.socsoEisDownloadTitle: Combined SOCSO + EIS contribution textfile (ASSIST, v2.0 with SKBBK)
statutoryForms.legendTitle: What the status on each form means
statutoryForms.fidelity_official_hint: The government’s own printed form, filled in from your payroll. Today: CP22 only.
statutoryForms.fidelity_figures_hint: Every number the form needs, complete and ready to download or print — laid out our way, not on the agency’s own document.
statutoryForms.fidelity_draft_file_hint: Built to the file layout the agency publishes for portal uploads, but never yet accepted by that portal, so it stays marked draft.
statutoryForms.fidelity_planned_hint: Named here so you can see the whole list — but there is no button, because there is nothing behind it yet.
statutoryForms.searchNoMatch: No form on this shelf matches your search.
statutoryForms.link_ea_blank_title: A completely blank EA — every heading, box, caption, note and signature area, with no figures and no employee details in it. It follows the C.P.8A (Pin. 2023) arrangement but is printed on paper of ours: we hold no blank C.P.8A from LHDN, so this is our rendering of that layout, not the agency’s artwork. Print it and hold it beside the agency’s own form.
statutoryForms.link_ea_register_title: Every box on the EA form, listed with its official section, its official box number, the agency’s own wording, the kind of value it takes, and what feeds it today — or “nothing feeds this yet”. A Markdown file in English, to work down box by box beside the blank form.
statutoryForms.desc_ea_en: Each employee’s annual statement of remuneration, always in English. Drawn to the C.P.8A (Pin. 2023) arrangement, on paper of ours — we hold no blank C.P.8A from LHDN.
statutoryForms.desc_ea_ms: The same statement, always in Bahasa Malaysia. Drawn to the C.P.8A (Pin. 2023) arrangement, on paper of ours — we hold no blank C.P.8A from LHDN.
statutoryForms.link_borang_e_hint: The annual employer return, including the Part A head counts.
statutoryForms.desc_borang_e: Borang E and CP8D are produced together in ONE step — opening either gives you the employer head counts and the per-employee schedule at once, not two separate documents. Our layout, not LHDN’s printed Form E.
statutoryForms.desc_cp8d: The per-employee annual schedule. Produced in the same step as Borang E — opening either gives you both, so there is no second document to wait for. Our column layout, not LHDN’s CP8D template.
statutoryForms.desc_cp22: Produced on LHDN’s own published CP22 [Pin.1/2021] — the two-page form that superseded Pin. 1/2020 — filled in from the joiner’s record, with a review step before anything is produced. Fifteen boxes are left blank on purpose, because we do not hold what goes in them.
statutoryForms.desc_cp39: Every employee’s monthly tax deduction for the period, with the e-Data PCB upload file alongside it.
statutoryForms.desc_epf: Every employee’s wages, employee share and employer share for the month.
statutoryForms.desc_socso_eis: One combined monthly return — SOCSO and EIS go up together through PERKESO ASSIST.
statutoryForms.link_tp1_hint: The employee’s own declaration of tax reliefs, one per deduction month. Choose a person and a month to open, correct or print theirs.
statutoryForms.desc_tp1: LHDN’s TP1 (1/2026), drawn from the declaration already on file — Sections A to F, items C1 to C17 and the D1 rebate, in the form’s own numbering, wording and column order, on our own page. One form per employee per deduction month; nothing on it is recalculated here.
statutoryForms.desc_hrd_levy: Every employee’s HRD Corp levy for the month, taken from the payroll run and never recalculated. The levy is employer-only — nothing is deducted from anybody’s pay — and an employee the levy does not cover shows zero rather than being left off the list.
statutoryForms.planned_epf_borang_bbcb_hint: Not built — and the name on its own has not let us identify which EPF form this is, so we will confirm that with you before anyone starts.
statutoryForms.planned_perkeso_sip_hint: The Employment Insurance System forms. Not built.
statutoryForms.planned_perkeso_employee_registration_hi: PERKESO registration for a new employee. Not built.
statutoryForms.planned_lhdn_cp21_hint: Notification that an employee is leaving Malaysia. Not built.
statutoryForms.planned_lhdn_cp22a_hint: Leavers needing a CP22A are already flagged on the CP22 / CP22A worklist further down this screen, but the notice itself is not built.
statutoryForms.planned_lhdn_cp39a_hint: The statement of tax deducted on arrear payments. Not built.
statutoryForms.fidelity_agency_layout_hint: Drawn box for box to match the agency’s own form, but on our page — we hold no blank from the agency to print onto.
statutoryForms.desc_borang_8a: The PERKESO monthly contribution schedule: one SOCSO figure per person, taken from the payroll run and never recalculated, with the contribution month and the payment deadline printed on the form itself.

config.title: Statutory Configuration
config.subtitle: The exact Malaysian statutory figures the payroll engine applies — EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB and overtime. Inspect every value with its official source, or publish an effective-dated override.
config.editIntro: Editing legal figures changes FUTURE payroll only — past payslips keep their snapshot. The verified built-in defaults are never lost; they remain the fallback. Bump the version and set an effective date.
config.safetyNote: Wrong values produce wrong, non-compliant payslips. Every figure here is sourced and verified — change it only against an official publication.
config.notesPlaceholder: e.g. EPF employee rate restored to 11% per Budget 2027
config.otMultipliersNote: The 1.5× workday rate and the base-day pay (½/1-day rest-day, 2 days for a public holiday) are fixed by the Employment Act. The rest-day and public-holiday excess-hours rates default to the legal 2× / 3× and can be adjusted here.
config.reliefsPendingSignOffNote: These figures come from a reputable published summary rather than the official document, because the official page is offline. They are the numbers the calculation actually applies. Check each one against the current official publication and confirm it before the first payroll run that relies on it.
config.pcbBands: Tax bands (Table 1: P, M, R, B)
config.bandsReadOnly: Exact agency schedule — {count} bands verified to the RM6,000 ceiling. Maintained as sourced data (a published schedule change is a data update), not hand-edited here.
config.noHistory: No stored overrides. The engine is running on the built-in verified defaults.
config.packsNone: No vendor packs ingested — running on the built-in verified default. Deploy runbook: db:migrate → statutory:sync.
config.staleWarn: A newer statutory pack ({available}) is available but not ingested (latest ingested: {ingested}). Run statutory:sync to apply it.
config.syncFailed: The last sync had {count} failure(s) — check the sync log.
config.perBodySubtitle: Each statutory body resolves its own effective version independently.
config.componentIntro: Publish an effective-dated override for a single body (EPF rates, overtime ceiling, or HRDF rates) without re-issuing the whole ruleset.
config.editSectionIntro: Publish an effective-dated override for this body. The verified defaults stay the fallback; past payslips keep their snapshot.
config.ceilingsNote: Overtime rates are configured under the Attendance module (Shift settings → Overtime rates), not here.
config.bandsEditWarning: Verified PERKESO schedule — edit only for a known statutory change. Wage ranges must ascend without gaps, and amounts are fixed ringgit values, not percentages. A bad edit can be reverted by archiving this version to restore the built-in schedule.
config.socsoCat2: Category 2 — injury only (age 60+ / foreign, employer only)
config.epfPartA: Third Schedule — Part A (citizen / PR, under 60)
config.epfPartE: Third Schedule — Part E (citizen 60 to under 75)
config.epfBandsNote: Amounts are ringgit per wage band, rounded up to the next ringgit. The last row ("and above") is the exact-percentage tail beyond the schedule cap. Leave a row's "Wage to" empty to make it the open-ended top band.
config.epfPartENote: Reduced senior schedule: employee 0%, employer 4%. Applies to Malaysian citizens aged 60 to under 75; no mandatory contribution from age 75.
config.hrdfNote: HRD Corp (PSMB Act 2001) levy rates applied to eligible employers.
config.skbbkDesc: The employee-paid SKBBK (Lindung 24 Jam) contribution schedule — carried on the SOCSO bands and applied by payroll from 1 June 2026.
config.skbbkAbout: SKBBK is an employee-paid leg that rides on the SOCSO contribution bands. It is maintained together with SOCSO — publishing a SOCSO override updates these figures. The employer and SOCSO employee columns are unchanged.
config.skbbkBothCategories: Identical for Category 1 and Category 2 — {count} bands verified to the RM6,000 ceiling. Employees aged 60 and above and foreign workers contribute too.
config.skbbkEditNote: SKBBK amounts are the SKBBK (RM) column of the SOCSO band tables below. Edit them here and publish — the change is saved as a SOCSO statutory version.
config.childQualificationQNote: Changing relief per child changes the deduction for future payroll. It does not change qualifying-child counts.
config.childQualificationExplicitNote: Qualifying-child weights are recorded separately from the relief per child.
config.childQualificationLegacyNote: This earlier configuration records category relief amounts. Publishing an update will preserve its current qualifying-child weights before applying any new relief per child.
config.childQualificationInvalid: Child relief settings are inconsistent. Review the qualifying-child weights and category amounts before processing payroll or publishing the configuration.

fixed.title: Fixed Transaction
fixed.subtitle: Recurring fixed pay items for one employee, effective-dated.
fixed.intro: Add a fixed amount for a pay item over a date range. It applies to payroll runs whose period falls in that range. Changes take effect on the next generated payslip.
fixed.empty: No employees in the current scope.
fixed.noTransactions: No fixed transactions for this employee yet.
fixed.required: Employee, pay item, cycle, start date and amount are required.
fixed.outOfScope: That employee is not in your current company scope.
fixed.dateError: End date cannot be before the start date.
fixed.currencyUnsupported: Only MYR is supported — payroll is computed in MYR.
fixed.amountError: Amount must be greater than zero.
fixed.editHint: Saving records the new value from the effective date forward and keeps the earlier history.
fixed.stopHint: The item keeps paying up to this date, then stops in later payroll runs.
fixed.deleteBody: This removes the item from the list and excludes it from all payroll calculations. This cannot be undone.
fixed.notFound: That fixed transaction no longer exists.
fixed.showingCapped: Showing first {cap} of {total} matches — refine your search.
fixed.pickEmployeeBody: Their recurring pay items appear here once you choose someone from the list.
fixed.searchTxnPlaceholder: Search pay item, amount, date or remarks
fixed.noMatches: No recurring pay items match your search.
fixed.detailSubtitle: View or change this recurring pay item.
fixed.versioningTitle: Changing this item does not overwrite it.
fixed.versioningBody: Saving closes the current value from the effective date you choose and starts a new one, so the history stays intact. Two records for the same pay item can never cover the same day: if your dates run into a record that is already there, the save is refused and the message names it. That means each change adds a line to the list.
fixed.versioningNote: A change adds a line: editing an item closes its current value from the chosen date and starts a new one, so the history stays intact. Two records for the same pay item can never cover the same day.
fixed.deleteHint: Removing an item hides it and excludes it from all future payroll. This stays possible after a pay run has been processed, so a wrong item can be taken out and the run reprocessed. Once a run is closed it can no longer be removed for that period — end it from a date instead, which stops future payments while leaving what was already paid untouched.
fixed.paidOnPayslip: Pay run {period} is closed, so this item can no longer be changed or removed for that period. Reopen the run, or end the item from a date instead — that stops future payments and leaves what was already paid intact.
fixed.overlap: This employee already has a {code} record covering {from} to {to}. End that record first, or choose dates that do not overlap it.
fixed.backwards: This employee already has a {code} record starting {from}. A new value must take effect on or after that date.
fixed.midMonth: A change to the {code} pay item has to take effect on the first of a month. This employee already has a live {code} record covering part of that month, so a change dated part-way through it would pay both records in full. Use {nextFirst}.
fixed.existingTitle: This employee already has {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} for this pay item
fixed.existingClash: Your dates run into a record above. Saving will be refused — end that record first, or change your dates.

individual.title: Individual Transaction
individual.subtitle: One-off batch components.
individual.noBatches: No draft batch available. Create one from the Payroll Process tab first.
individual.addIntro: Add a single one-off pay component for one employee on this draft batch.
individual.csvIntro: Load many one-off components at once.
individual.unsupportedComponent: That component cannot be used on a batch in this version. Pick a payable component.

individual.txnEmpty: No individual transactions for this batch yet.
individual.deleteBody: This removes the individual transaction from the batch. This cannot be undone.
individual.dateOutOfPeriod: The transaction date is outside the selected pay-period month.
individual.notDraft: This payroll run is closed, so its transactions can no longer be changed.
individual.deductionIntro: Monthly tax relief (TP1) and zakat for one employee. Saving these does not change overtime or bonus on the same row.
individual.tp1Title: Monthly tax deduction relief (TP1) — reduces PCB/MTD.
individual.zakatTitle: Zakat paid via salary — credited against PCB/MTD.
individual.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or employee ID…
individual.noDraftForSelection: No draft run for this period and cycle.
individual.rowIncomplete: Some rows are incomplete or invalid — fix the highlighted rows before saving.
individual.amountNotPositive: Amount must be greater than zero.
individual.companyMismatch: This employee does not belong to the selected run's company.
individual.employeeNotInScope: {employee} is not one of the people covered by the {period} payroll run — {scope, select, departments {that run was set up for selected departments only} employees {that run was set up for a named list of employees} other {that run was set up for selected departments and named employees}}. {canAdd, select, yes {Add this employee to the run, or record the entry against a different run.} other {This employee was not employed during that pay period, so they cannot be added to that run — record the entry against a run for a month they were employed.}}
individual.scopeConfirmBody: {employee} is not one of the people covered by the {period} payroll run — {scope, select, departments {that run was set up for selected departments only} employees {that run was set up for a named list of employees} other {that run was set up for selected departments and named employees}}.
individual.scopeConfirmEffect: {processed, select, yes {Continue adds {employee} to the run, saves this transaction, and marks them for reprocessing so their payroll result is brought up to date. Cancel saves nothing.} other {Continue adds {employee} to the run and saves this transaction. Cancel saves nothing.}}
individual.scopeConfirmSaved: {employee} has been added to the {period} payroll run and the transaction has been saved.
individual.scopeConfirmSavedRecalc: {employee} has been added to the {period} payroll run, the transaction has been saved, and they are marked for reprocessing.
individual.addToRunDenied: You do not have permission to add an employee to a payroll run that has already been processed.
individual.employeeNotInScopeNoDetail: This employee is not one of the people covered by the selected payroll run. Choose a different run, or add the employee to that run from the entry form.
individual.addToRunNotEmployed: This employee was not employed during that pay period, so they cannot be added to the run. Record the entry against a run for a month they were employed.
individual.alreadyNone: Nothing entered for this month yet.
individual.alreadyUnpaid: {count, plural, one {# not yet paid} other {# not yet paid}}
individual.alreadyUnpaidHint: Some of these were entered but have not reached a payslip. Only the month's regular payroll run collects them — an off-cycle or bonus run does not.
individual.applyAllHint: Each row will be recorded for all {count} selected employees.
individual.coverageGapHint: Some selected employees are not in this run: {names}
individual.noSharedDraft: No draft run covers all the selected employees.
individual.duplicateRow: Duplicate rows are not allowed — two entries have the same item, date, amount, and remarks.
individual.noDraftYetNotice: No draft payroll run exists for {period} yet. Entries will be saved for this month and picked up automatically when the regular run is generated.
individual.cycleAwaitingRun: No {cycle} payroll run exists for {period} yet. This entry is saved for that pay cycle and is picked up automatically when its run is generated.
individual.cycleLockedHint: This transaction is already on a payroll run, so its pay cycle cannot be changed here.
individual.cycleInvalid: That pay cycle cannot be used for this transaction. Choose an active pay cycle for this company.
individual.unattachedHint: These entries were keyed in before a payroll run existed for their month. Each one attaches to its month’s regular run when that run is calculated for the first time — provided the run covers that employee. A run narrowed to some employees leaves the rest outstanding, and anything keyed in after a run is calculated is not picked up.
individual.componentRequired: Pick a pay item for each earning or deduction row — one-off pay items are paid through payroll, so the item's statutory treatment must be defined.
individual.componentInvalid: The selected pay item is not valid for this row (unknown, archived, or the wrong type).
individual.componentRequiredHint: Earnings and deductions are paid through payroll: pick a named pay item from the list (its EPF/SOCSO/PCB treatment applies). Overtime, unpaid and leave entries do not need one.
individual.employeesPanelHint: Pick an employee to see and change their one-off transactions.
individual.pickEmployeeBody: Their existing one-off transactions load here, and you can add, edit, delete or duplicate them without leaving this page.
individual.duplicateHint: A copy of an existing entry — change what differs before saving.
individual.strandedTitle: Money that has already missed its payroll run
individual.strandedHint: Only a month’s regular payroll run collects these entries, and that run has already been processed — they will not be picked up.
individual.amountIsFinalHint: The amount entered here is the amount paid. A pay item’s formula is not applied to one-off transactions.
individual.identicalWarning: An identical entry already exists for this employee (same item, date, amount and remarks). Save only if it is genuinely a second one.
individual.lockedHint: This transaction is on a payroll run that has been closed, so it can no longer be changed or removed.
individual.unsavedBody: Do you want to save before switching to another employee?
individual.outOfScope: You do not administer that company.
individual.noTxnsYet: No one-off transactions for this employee yet.
individual.deleteTxnBody: This permanently removes the transaction. It cannot be undone.
individual.processedEditTitle: This payroll run has already been processed.
individual.processedEditPaymentExported: A bank payment file has already been exported for it.
individual.processedEditStatutoryFiled: {count} statutory return(s) for this month have already been filed with their agency.
individual.processedEditMarksRecalc: Saving marks the run as needing recalculation, and it cannot be closed until that is done.
individual.recalcNeededTitle: This payroll run now needs recalculation.
individual.recalcNeededBody: Its payslips, statutory figures and totals no longer match the transactions behind them.
individual.paidEditableHint: This transaction has already been paid on a processed run. It can still be corrected, and doing so marks the run for recalculation.
individual.stalePendingHint: This transaction is not in the employee’s latest payslip — it was added or changed after the run was calculated. Reprocess the run to include it.
individual.employeeReprocessHint: This employee’s payslip on this run is waiting to be recalculated, for a change made somewhere other than this transaction.
individual.quantityRequiredHours: Enter the number of hours — this pay item works the amount out from them.
individual.quantityRequiredDays: Enter the number of days — this pay item works the amount out from them.
individual.derivedAmountUnavailable: This pay item’s amount could not be worked out. Check how it is set up under Payroll Items.

derivedAmountHint.hours: This pay item calculates its own amount. Enter the hours and the amount is worked out from the item’s formula — it is not typed in.
derivedAmountHint.days: This pay item calculates its own amount. Enter the days and the amount is worked out from the item’s formula — it is not typed in.
derivedAmountHint.none: This pay item calculates its own amount from its formula, so the amount is not typed in.

individual.dayGridSaved: {count, plural, one {# transaction saved} other {# transactions saved}}
individual.dayGridEmpty: Add at least one date before saving.
individual.dayGridRoundingHint: Each date is worked out and rounded to the cent on its own, so a set of dates can total a cent away from the same quantity entered as one figure.
individual.dayGridNoRuleHint: This pay item has no formula set, so the amount for each date is entered by hand. Set a formula on the item in Payroll Item Master and it will be worked out for you.
individual.dayGridViewDays: Show the dates behind this total

guide.title: Payroll Workflow Guide
guide.subtitle: The end-to-end payroll process, in order: prepare master data, enter transactions, validate readiness, process, review, then finalize.
guide.readinessBlocked: {n, plural, one {# blocker} other {# blockers}} must be fixed before processing.
guide.readinessWarnings: {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to review.
guide.phase1Desc: Complete employee master data, statutory settings, pay items, policies, schedules and cycles before processing begins.
guide.phase2Desc: Record all fixed and one-off transactions — allowances, deductions, overtime, claims, leave and statutory adjustments — for the month.
guide.phase3Desc: Confirm every required configuration is complete. Blockers stop processing; warnings should be reviewed first.
guide.phase4Desc: Run the calculation. The engine retrieves validated employee data, transactions and configuration and computes earnings, deductions, statutory contributions and net pay in one pass.
guide.phase4Processing: Processing runs in a single pass and is not a saved status — a run moves straight from Draft to Processed.
guide.phase5Desc: Review the detailed per-employee breakdown — basic pay, earnings, allowances, overtime, claims, EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB, zakat, gross and net pay — before finalizing.
guide.phase6Desc: Once verified, progress the run Draft → Processed → Closed. Corrections can reopen a run or reprocess selected employees before closure.

backPay.title: Back Pay (Arrears)
backPay.subtitle: Work out what a backdated salary change owes, month by month, and pay it on the current payroll.
backPay.noHistoryChange: No closed payroll is reopened and no past payslip is changed. Approved arrears are posted as new one-off payments on the current month, so they attract EPF, SOCSO and PCB in the month they are actually paid.
backPay.detected: Backdated salary changes not yet paid
backPay.noneDetected: No backdated salary change is waiting to be paid for this company.
backPay.targetPeriodHint: The arrears are added to this month’s payroll. The months above are never recalculated.
backPay.needsReviewNote: {count} line(s) need a figure from you. They are shown but not included in the total, and nothing is posted for them — key those amounts as ordinary one-off transactions.
backPay.postingNote: Approve and post creates one one-off payment per employee per covered month on the pay month above. A negative figure posts as a deduction.
backPay.noRuns: No back pay has been calculated yet.

review.manualOvertime: Overtime was typed in by hand — only an amount was kept, never the hours, so it cannot be re-priced.
review.overtimeDeferred: Overtime arrears are part of the next delivery, after the attendance calculation change.
review.hoursNotStored: This item is calculated from hours, and hours are not kept on a payslip.
review.blendedOriginal: Two salary records applied to this month when it was paid, so the original cannot be reproduced exactly.
review.nonMonthlyPayMode: This employee is paid by the day or the hour, so a monthly salary change is not what moved their pay.
review.nonPayableItem: This item is recorded but never paid in cash, so a difference on it is not money.
review.noBaselineSalary: The salary baseline used for this paid month is unavailable or cannot be verified. Review is required before calculating back pay.
review.unpaidLeaveInPeriod: This month had unpaid leave. A backdated salary change also changes the unpaid-leave deduction, which is part of the next delivery — so the month is shown and left for you to work out rather than paid at a figure we know is too high.

errors.nothingToCalculate: Nothing to calculate — no backdated salary change produced a difference.
errors.targetRunNotDraft: The payroll run for that month has already been processed. Back pay can only be added while it is still a draft.
errors.wrongStatus: This back pay is not in a state that allows that action.
errors.notFound: That back pay could not be found.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

ok.posted: Approved and posted to the current payroll.
ok.cancelled: Cancelled. Any postings it created have been removed.

statutoryDetail.agencySocso: Paid to the Social Security Organisation (PERKESO).
statutoryDetail.basesNotRecordedBody: This payroll run was calculated before the system began saving the wage each statutory body was charged on. The amounts below are exactly what was deducted and paid; the wage behind them cannot be shown, and it is deliberately not guessed from gross pay — an explanation that disagreed with the payslip would be worse than none.
statutoryDetail.basesNotRecordedHeading: The working behind this payslip was not recorded
statutoryDetail.effectiveRateEpfNote: EPF is not a flat percentage of the exact wage. For a monthly wage up to RM20,000 the amount is the figure the KWSP Third Schedule sets for that wage band, rounded up to the next ringgit; only above RM20,000 does the percentage itself apply, and that is rounded up too. A bonus paid in the same month is added to the wage before that band is chosen, so the month is looked up once. The percentage shown here is the effective rate that produced this amount, given for checking only.
statutoryDetail.effectiveRateNote: The percentage is the rate this run actually applied, worked out as the amount divided by the wage recorded above.
statutoryDetail.effectiveRateScheduleNote: The amount comes from the PERKESO contribution schedule for the wage band, not from multiplying by a percentage. The percentage shown is the effective rate that produced it, given for checking only.
statutoryDetail.employerBorneNote: This employer funds part of the employee's statutory share. The Employee column above is the full share as filed with each body; the two lines below show what the company paid and what was really deducted from take-home pay.
statutoryDetail.fieldEmployerBorne: Borne by the employer on the employee's behalf
statutoryDetail.fieldEmployerBorneTotal: Total borne by the employer on the employee's behalf
statutoryDetail.incrementalNote: This is a bonus or off-cycle run, so the amount is only the increase it added on top of what the month had already contributed, while the wage above is the whole month’s. The two do not divide into a rate, so no percentage is shown here.
statutoryDetail.manualBannerBody: A payroll officer entered these amounts under Payroll, Statutory Adjustment, so no statutory rule produced them. No percentage is shown for them, because a typed amount has no rate behind it, and the figure the system had calculated is shown beside the figure that was used. An adjustment to one line never re-derives another: setting EPF by hand does not change the tax figure beside it.
statutoryDetail.manualBannerHeading: At least one figure on this payslip was set by hand
statutoryDetail.manualNote: This amount was entered by a payroll officer, not worked out by a rule. The wage above is the wage the system would have charged on, shown for context only: no percentage can be worked out between that wage and this amount.
statutoryDetail.noEmployee: Choose an employee to see how their statutory deductions were worked out.
statutoryDetail.noPayslip: This employee has no payslip in the selected period.
statutoryDetail.noSelection: Choose a payslip to see how its statutory deductions were worked out.
statutoryDetail.otherRunsHint: More than one payroll run matches this company, year, month and cycle — for example a bonus run beside the regular one. Choose the one to explain.
statutoryDetail.payslipHint: The wage each body was charged on, the rule applied, and the employee and employer amounts — read from what this payroll run recorded, not recalculated.
statutoryDetail.ruleManual: Set by hand (no rule produced this amount)
statutoryDetail.subtitle: How EPF, SOCSO, SKBBK, EIS, HRD Corp and PCB were worked out on this payslip.
statutoryDetail.summaryHint: Employee and employer amounts for every statutory item on this payslip, so the totals can be checked before any single working is opened.
statutoryDetail.title: Statutory Explanation
statutoryDetail.wholeMonthNote: This is a bonus or off-cycle run. The statutory wages shown are the whole month's cumulative figures, which is what the run was assessed against — they are not the money this run alone paid. The amounts are the increase this run added on top of what the month had already contributed, so no percentage rate can be worked out between the two.
statutoryDetail.workingMtd: Income tax is not a percentage of the wage. It is worked out from the year's estimated income, the employee's reliefs and the tax table. The full working is on the PCB calculation screen.
statutoryDetail.workingNilCharge: Nothing was charged for this item on this payroll run.
statutoryDetail.workingNotRecorded: This run did not record the wage this was charged on, so the working cannot be shown. The amounts below are what was actually deducted and paid.
statutoryDetail.manualBannerBodyElection: This employee's EPF Category is a fixed monthly amount, entered on their own record under Personnel Management, Bank and Statutory — so no contribution schedule produced this figure. It is applied by every payroll run and reprocess until the category is changed. No percentage is shown for it, because a typed amount has no rate behind it, and the figure the system would have calculated is shown beside the figure that was used. Changing the amount will move any run that is reprocessed afterwards and is not yet closed.
statutoryDetail.manualReasonElection: Reason recorded for the fixed EPF amount

borang8a.title: Borang 8A — monthly contribution schedule

borang8a.noBatch: No payroll run found for {company} · {period}. Run payroll for this month first.
borang8a.notFound: That form is not available for the selected company.
borang8a.tileMonthHint: The payroll month itself, with no shift.
borang8a.tileDueHint: The last day of the contribution month.
borang8a.reconTitle: Reconciliation — the run’s own figures beside the form’s
borang8a.missingTitle: {count, plural, one {# employee cannot go on the form yet:} other {# employees cannot go on the form yet:}}
borang8a.missingHint: Fix what is named against each person and come back — nothing can be downloaded until every row is complete.
borang8a.statusHint: Column (2) STATUS is left blank for anyone who neither joined nor left this month, exactly as a filed Borang 8A leaves it. Type one against a row if you need it — nothing is saved.
borang8a.colIc: (3) No. Kad Pengenalan — identity card no.
borang8a.noEmployees: No employees in this payroll run.
borang8a.pageTotal: Jumlah muka surat ini — sheet {sheet} of {of}
borang8a.downloadPdfTitle: The drawn Borang 8A, paginated, with a total on every sheet.
borang8a.downloadTextTitle: The same content as plain text, laid out to READ from while you key the figures into PERKESO ASSIST by hand. This is NOT the file the portal accepts.
borang8a.downloadFileTitle: THE FILE YOU UPLOAD to the PERKESO ASSIST Portal: fixed width, 278 characters a line, one record per employee. Every record is checked before it is offered. It is not laid out to be read — use the readable copy above for that.
borang8a.checkFileTitle: Every record, field by field, with its character positions — read this before uploading.
borang8a.mycoidNoticeTitle: The MyCoID / business registration number will go out as an empty box.
borang8a.mycoidNoticeBody: PERKESO marks that field as not mandatory, so the upload file is still produced — positions 13 to 32 of every record simply carry twenty spaces. If the file you filed before carries a number there, set it under Organization → Statutory identity, then download again.
borang8a.downloadsBlocked: Downloads are blocked until every row has an identity card number.
borang8a.headerMissingTitle: This company cannot produce a Borang 8A yet:
borang8a.headerMissingHint: Set it under Organization → Statutory identity, then come back. Without it every page of the form has a gap in the same box.
borang8a.unfinishedNameTitle: Some employee names do not look finished.
borang8a.unfinishedNameHint: PERKESO’s name box is “name as per IC or passport”. These are the names saved on the staff records — the file carries them exactly as they are and never shortens or invents one. Uploading as they stand files these contributions under these names. Correct them on the staff record, then come back. Nothing here stops the download.
borang8a.oneLineNoticeTitle: Each employee is one long line in the upload file.
borang8a.oneLineNoticeBody: Every record is a single line of {length} characters, with nothing in the middle of it. If you open the file in Notepad or another editor with word wrap turned on, one employee will look as though they have been split over two lines — that is the editor folding a long line to fit the window, not a break in the file. Turn word wrap off and each employee sits on one line. “Check the file” shows every field with PERKESO’s own numbering.

borangA.noBatch: No payroll run found for {company} · {period}. Run payroll for this month first.
borangA.notFound: That form is not available for the selected company.
borangA.tileMonthHint: The payroll month plus one, which is note 6 on the form itself.
borangA.tileWageHint: What EPF was charged on, never gross pay.
borangA.reconTitle: Reconciliation — the run’s own figures beside the form’s
borangA.periodOverridden: You have set the contribution month to {month}. The rule on the form is the payroll month ({payroll}) plus one. We are not stopping you — some employers file early or late on purpose.
borangA.headerMissingTitle: This company cannot produce a Borang A yet:
borangA.headerMissingHint: Set it under Organization → Statutory identity, then come back. Without it every page of the form has a gap in the same box.

borangA.fileBlockedHint: The upload file’s fields are fixed-width and numeric, so a value the printed page can carry may still be one the file cannot. Fix these and the file becomes available.

borangA.repMissingHint: Set it under Organization → Statutory authorities → EPF. This does not stop the download; the form simply prints a blank line to write on, exactly as a blank Borang A does.
borangA.inputsHint: The last three are for the i-Akaun upload file only and are never saved. The employer short code has no field anywhere in the system, so it is typed each time. Leave the control number blank and the file works it out for itself — it is the sum of the EPF member numbers on the file; fill it in only if KWSP asks you for a particular value.

borangA.fileBlocked: The upload file is blocked until the records above are fixed.

cp39Form.title: CP39 — monthly PCB / MTD statement (LHDN)
cp39Form.notArtworkTitle: Our paper, drawn to LHDN’s form.
cp39Form.notArtwork: Page one follows the Borang CP39 (Pin.2015) arrangement — the masthead, the payment panel and the printed A / B / C notes — traced from a filled specimen of that form, and we hold no copy of LHDN’s own blank form. The paper is still ours, not the agency’s artwork. LHDN has not accepted a paper CP39 since September 2019: keep this for your records and as a payment cover document, and file through e-PCB / e-Data PCB / e-CP39.
cp39Form.noBatch: No payroll run found for {company} · {period}. Run payroll for this month first.
cp39Form.notFound: That form is not available for the selected company.
cp39Form.tileMonthHint: The payroll month itself, with no shift.
cp39Form.tilePcbHint: {count, plural, one {# employee deducted} other {# employees deducted}}
cp39Form.tileCp38Hint: {count, plural, one {# employee on an instalment} other {# employees on an instalment}}
cp39Form.headerMissingTitle: This company cannot produce a CP39 yet:
cp39Form.headerMissingHint: Set it under Organization → Statutory identity, then come back. Without it every page of the statement has a gap in the same box.
cp39Form.headerField_employerNo: LHDN employer number (No. Majikan, the “E” number)
cp39Form.missingTitle: {count, plural, one {# employee cannot go on the statement yet:} other {# employees cannot go on the statement yet:}}
cp39Form.missingHint: Add the income tax reference number on the staff record and come back — nothing can be downloaded until every row is complete. It is the same field the e-Data PCB file refuses without.
cp39Form.dupTinTitle: {count, plural, one {# income tax reference number is filed against more than one employee:} other {# income tax reference numbers are filed against more than one employee:}}
cp39Form.dupTinHint: This is what is stored on the staff records, not a fault in the statement — the CP39 and the e-Data PCB file both print exactly what is filed under each employee. Correct whichever record is wrong under Personnel → the employee → Identity & tax. This does not stop the download.
cp39Form.unfinishedNameTitle: {count, plural, one {# employee name still looks unfinished:} other {# employee names still look unfinished:}}
cp39Form.unfinishedNameHint: These are the names saved on the staff records, not something the statement invented — the CP39 and the e-Data PCB file both print the name on file. Correct them under Personnel → the employee → Person details before you file. This does not stop the download.
cp39Form.prepMissingTitle: The preparer block (Pegawai Yang Menyediakan Maklumat) is incomplete:
cp39Form.prepMissingHint: Set the defaults under Organization → Statutory authorities → LHDN, or type them in above for this one statement. This does not stop the download; the form simply prints a blank line to write on.
cp39Form.blankColumnsTitle: Two columns come from the staff record.
cp39Form.blankColumnsHint: No. K/P Lama and Kod Negara are printed from the employee’s Profile tab, and are blank only when nothing is on file there. Kod Negara is the two-letter passport issuing code and you choose it yourself — it is never derived from the nationality text beside it, because “Malaysian” is not “MY” and a guessed code on a tax document is worse than an empty box.
cp39Form.inputsHint: These fill the “Pegawai Yang Menyediakan Maklumat” box and are never saved — they default from Organization → Statutory authorities → LHDN, and leaving one blank keeps that default. The signature stays blank for signing by hand.
cp39Form.payRef: Cheque / bank draft / postal order no.
cp39Form.paymentHint: The payment instrument (Butir-Butir Pembayaran). Nothing in payroll knows these, so they start empty and are never saved — fill them in when you have the cheque, bank draft or postal order in front of you, or leave them blank and the statement prints a ruled line to write on.
cp39Form.deductedOnly: Only employees with a PCB or CP38 deduction are listed: {count} of the {paid} people this payroll run paid. A CP39 is a statement of deductions. Each Bilangan Pekerja figure above counts one deduction only, so somebody on a CP38 instalment with no PCB is a row here but not in the PCB count — the number of rows is the number of people with at least one deduction.
cp39Form.noEmployees: No employees in this payroll run.
cp39Form.noDeductions: Nobody had tax deducted this month. The payroll run paid {paid} — a CP39 lists only employees with a PCB or CP38 deduction.

cp39Form.downloadTextTitle: The same content as plain text, laid out to READ from while you key the figures into LHDN’s e-PCB portal by hand. This is NOT the e-Data PCB file LHDN ingests — that is the button beside it.

cp39Form.downloadFileTitle: The file LHDN’s e-PCB / e-Data PCB portal ingests (Exhibit 4): fixed width, 136 characters per employee line, no separators, zero-padded amounts. Every line is checked before it is offered. It is not laid out to be read — use the readable copy for that. DRAFT until verified against e-PCB Plus.
cp39Form.downloadsBlocked: Downloads are blocked until every row above is complete.
cp39Form.pcbPaymentHint: The receipt number and date LHDN gave you when you paid. PCB 2(II) prints these; a month left blank prints an empty box.

pcbDetail.exemptionNone: No applicable exemption types were recorded for this calculation.
pcbDetail.exemptionBasisNote: Accumulated is the amount used before this selected calculation, including TP3 and earlier runs. This Month shows the exemption assessment used by the selected calculation, including reused recurring benefits. Additional-run working describes the selected month calculation, not the incremental deduction. Reused amounts may already be in Accumulated; do not add these columns.
pcbDetail.exemptionIncompleteNote: This run has incomplete exemption records. Only known saved amounts are shown; annual limits, accumulated amounts and applicability are not reconstructed from current configuration.
pcbDetail.additionalMtdMonth: Additional MTD for the whole month
pcbDetail.bracketB: B — tax on M, after rebate
pcbDetail.bracketM: M — first chargeable income of the bracket
pcbDetail.bracketNote: M, R and B are the row of the LHDN tax table that P fell into. A negative B is the RM400 / RM800 rebate.
pcbDetail.bracketTaxOnP: Tax on P for the year
pcbDetail.category3: Category 3 — married and spouse working / divorced / widowed
pcbDetail.compAccNet: Σ(Y − K) — accumulated remuneration after EPF, prior months
pcbDetail.compEpfClaimed: K — EPF already claimed against the annual relief cap
pcbDetail.compK2: K₂ — estimated EPF for each remaining month
pcbDetail.compK2t: K₂ₜ — estimated EPF for each remaining month, re-estimated with the bonus
pcbDetail.compN: n — remaining months after this one
pcbDetail.compY2: Y₂ — estimated remuneration for each remaining month
pcbDetail.currencyNote: Amounts inside the formulas are shown without a currency prefix. They are all in {currency}.
pcbDetail.deltaBanner: This is an off-cycle or bonus run, so the tax deducted on this payslip is the INCREASE in the month's PCB, not the whole month's PCB. The working below is the month's: every figure in it, including the tax bracket and both MTD legs, describes the month with this run's pay included. The increase is shown separately, and it is the amount taken from this payslip.
pcbDetail.deltaEngineRun: Increase the system calculated for this run
pcbDetail.deltaHeading: This run deducted the month's increase
pcbDetail.deltaMonthTotal: PCB for the whole month, as calculated
pcbDetail.deltaNote: The steps above end at the month's PCB, because that is what the recorded working computes. This payslip deducted the difference between the month's PCB and what the month's earlier runs already covered.
pcbDetail.deltaOverrideBanner: This is an off-cycle or bonus run, so the working below describes the whole month rather than this payslip alone, and the tax on this payslip was afterwards entered manually. Three figures are therefore different: the month's calculated PCB, the increase the system worked out for this run, and the amount actually deducted.
pcbDetail.deltaOverrideHeading: This run deducted the month's increase, and it was then set by hand
pcbDetail.deltaOverrideNote: The steps above end at the month's PCB. The increase for this run was worked out from it, and the amount actually deducted was then set by hand — no calculation produced it.
pcbDetail.deltaPrior: PCB the month's earlier runs already covered
pcbDetail.finalPcbDeducted: PCB / MTD actually deducted (set by hand)
pcbDetail.finalPcbMonth: PCB / MTD for the whole month
pcbDetail.finalPcbRun: PCB / MTD deducted on this payslip (the increase)
pcbDetail.flatAdditional: Additional remuneration taxed at the flat rate
pcbDetail.nonresidentWorkingNote: This run uses the non-resident calculation recorded when payroll was processed.
pcbDetail.schemeWorkingNote: The formula uses the category and rebate recorded for this payroll run.
pcbDetail.flatNote: This historical run recorded a flat-rate calculation. Its saved working is preserved; it has not been recalculated using current category rules.
pcbDetail.flatRemuneration: Remuneration taxed at the flat rate
pcbDetail.flatRoundingNote: The flat-rate amount is truncated to two decimals and then rounded up to the next 5 sen, so the product above lands within 5 sen of the figure beside it rather than exactly on it. Separately, an amount below RM10 is not deducted at all — when that rule bites the figure beside it is nil, however large the product.
pcbDetail.floorHeading: Rounding, the zero floors and the RM10 rule
pcbDetail.floorNote: The specification's formulas print no floors; its rules apply them. An amount below zero is treated as 0.00, and a monthly tax deduction below RM10.00 is not deducted at all. That is why each substituted expression carries a zero floor the formula beside it does not, and why the two calculated amounts become A and E here.
pcbDetail.formulaHeading: Step 1 [C] — monthly tax deduction on net normal remuneration for the current month
pcbDetail.grossYNote: The accumulator kept for prior months is the remuneration ALREADY net of EPF, Σ(Y − K); the gross Y and its EPF are not stored separately, so they are not shown here rather than being guessed at.
pcbDetail.monthsDivisor: n + 1 — remaining months including this one
pcbDetail.monthsNote: n + 1 is the divisor, so it changes the deduction directly. X includes any amount reported from a previous employer.
pcbDetail.mtdAdditional: Monthly tax deduction on additional remuneration
pcbDetail.mtdNormal: Monthly tax deduction on normal remuneration
pcbDetail.netA: A — normal-remuneration MTD after the RM10 rule
pcbDetail.netE: E — additional-remuneration MTD after the RM10 rule
pcbDetail.netFormulaNote: An MTD below RM10 is not deducted at all, so each amount goes through that rule first — that is what turns the two calculated amounts into A and E. This month's zakat then reduces A, and only what A cannot absorb reaches E. Neither amount can go below zero.
pcbDetail.netHeading: Step 1 [D] — net monthly tax deduction for the current month
pcbDetail.netLeftover: Zakat left over after the normal leg, applied to the additional leg
pcbDetail.netMtdMonth: Net monthly tax deduction for the whole month
pcbDetail.netMtdNote: The deducted figure is already net of this month's zakat and of the RM10 minimum rule. It is the amount taken from pay and filed with LHDN — nothing on this screen is added to it or taken off it again.
pcbDetail.netMtdRun: PCB deducted on this payslip (the increase)
pcbDetail.netMtdSystem: Net monthly tax deduction the system calculated
pcbDetail.netZ1: Z₁ — zakat paid through salary this month
pcbDetail.noSelection: Open this screen from the PCB / MTD amount on a payslip or on Transaction Detail.
pcbDetail.notFound: That payslip is not available to you, or it no longer exists.
pcbDetail.overrideApplied: PCB deducted after the manual adjustment
pcbDetail.overrideBanner: The tax deduction on this payslip was entered manually, so the working below is not an explanation of it. Everything on this screen describes the figure the system calculated; the amount actually deducted is the adjusted figure.
pcbDetail.overrideHeading: This PCB was set by hand
pcbDetail.overrideNote: The steps above end at the figure the system calculated. The deducted amount was set by hand afterwards, and no calculation produced it.
pcbDetail.p2Formula: P₂ = [ Σ(Y − K*) + (Y₁ − K₁*) + [ (Y₂ − K₂ₜ*) n ] + (Yₜ − Kₜ*) ] − [ D + S + DU + SU + QC + (ΣLP + LP₁) ]
pcbDetail.p2Note: A month that pays additional remuneration is calculated twice from the same formula. The first calculation projects the year on normal remuneration alone, with (Yₜ − Kₜ) = 0; the second adds the additional remuneration and re-estimates the projected EPF as K₂ₜ, because the EPF on the additional payment has already used part of the same annual relief cap. The additional remuneration is never added to the first calculation.
pcbDetail.pFormula: P = [ Σ(Y − K*) + (Y₁ − K₁*) + [ (Y₂ − K₂*) n ] + (Yₜ − Kₜ*)** ] − [ D + S + DU + SU + QC + (ΣLP + LP₁) ]
pcbDetail.pFormulaNote: This is the specification's single formula for P. QC is one term — the child deduction already multiplied by the number of qualifying children; the Q and C rows above are its two factors. An asterisk marks the EPF terms, each of which is limited cumulatively against the annual EPF relief cap in this calculation. The double asterisk is the specification's own footnote: (Yₜ − Kₜ) applies only to the calculation of monthly tax deduction for additional remuneration.
pcbDetail.pHeading: Step 1 [B] — chargeable income for the year (P)
pcbDetail.pLegAdditional: Where (Yₜ − Kₜ) carries this month's additional remuneration, and the projected EPF is re-estimated as K₂ₜ.

pcbDetail.formulaNormalMtdNet: Net normal MTD = max(0, normal MTD after the minimum-deduction rule − current month’s Zakat/Fi/Levy)
pcbDetail.slipStep1NormalRules: The calculation applies the established truncation, five-sen rounding and minimum-deduction rules before the current-month rebate. Net normal MTD cannot be negative. Any remaining rebate follows the recorded additional-remuneration treatment; the combined final deduction is shown separately.
pcbDetail.slipStep1CombinedFormula: MTD (A) / Net MTD = [((P−M)R + B − (Z + X)) / (n + 1)] − Current month’s Zakat/Fi/Levy
